auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor asked for proof that ephemeral KMS envelope keys used by the inference service during the incident on 2024-09-12 were not re-used and that their usage is traceable. They want: key usage events, associated request IDs, and a mapping to service account rotations for a 4‑hour window around the incident. Can we provide guidance + export?

sasha: Yep. we can provide CloudTrail + KMS Admin events + our SIEM links. quick plan: 1) export KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt events for the window 2) correlate by RequestId and principalId 3) include service-account rotation logs from gitops and vault.

auditor_jane: For the sample we need the raw event JSON and a short mapping doc that ties requestId -> envelopeKeyId -> serviceAccount. also need to know if rotations were paused or forced during the incident.

maria: @sasha i'll start the SIEM query and package a minimal evidence set. question: do we want to pause rotation for the next 24h collection window? that could increase risk. recommend snapshot-only (no pause), but capture rotation events.

sasha: agree with snapshot-only. pausing rotation is high risk. we can freeze a copy in the evidence bucket and note rotation timestamps. i'll ping oncall to confirm.

ed: for correlation, use the KMS 'ciphertextBlob' metadata and the KMS keyId + alias. Splunk query I used earlier:
```
index=kms_logs eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt | table _time, requestParameters.ciphertextBlob, responseElements.keyId, userIdentity.principalId, requestID
```
Also collect CloudTrail entries:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --start-time 2024-09-12T02:00:00Z --end-time 2024-09-12T06:00:00Z --max-results 50
```

oncall_bot: Incident INC-4312 assigned to @sasha for evidence collection. attaching runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/forensics-collection

sasha: copying runbook steps 2/3 for audit export: create evidence manifest, export raw JSONs to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4312/kms/, generate SHA256 checksums, and sign manifest with ops-gpg.

auditor_jane: We'll accept JSON + manifest + checksums. also please include RBAC before/after snapshot for the service account (RoleBindings and IAM policies) — we need proof no elevated privileges were granted during the window.

maria: grabbing gitops commit range for rolebinding changes now. example commands i'm running:
```
git log --pretty=oneline --since="2024-09-11" --until="2024-09-13" -- k8s/rbac/*.yaml
kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml --all-namespaces | yq '.items[] | {metadata: .metadata, subjects: .subjects, roleRef: .roleRef}' > rolebindings_snapshot.yaml
```

ed: note: if service-account keys were rotated, include the Vault audit trail entry (vault audit list + accessor). that links vault token lifecycle to KMS ops.

evidence-bot: Evidence archive created: s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4312/kms/archive-20240912-0900.tar.gz (sha256: 3b7f...c1a). Manifest at s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4312/manifest.json

sasha: will attach the manifest and a short reconciliation doc mapping requestIDs -> envelopeKeyId -> principalId. expected delivery EOD today. tagging @auditor_jane for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:

auditor_jane: thanks — one small ask: can you include a short note about retention policy for KMS & CloudTrail and how that aligns with the sampling window? need that for control mapping.

sasha: added to doc: CloudTrail logs retained 90 days (standard), KMS Admin event retention mirrored in SIEM for 180 days, evidence extracts archived indefinitely in our evidence bucket per compliance policy. i'll include citations to retention config.

auditor_jane: perfect. if anything else blocks delivery please ping here.
